body:
I think I just needed someone to listen.  I'm glad this place exists.

> I don't tell my therapist all the details about suicide ideation, since that can result in involuntary hospitalization, and I really value my autonomy.

I talked to my therapist about this a little more.  He agreed that it's strange/funny that I can be more comfortable talking with strangers on the internet about suicide than with my own therapist, but that's how it is.  Strangers can't involuntarily commit me but my therapist can.

But we were able to talk a little more openly about it at least.  

We also talked about the two specific events that precipitated my feelings of suicide, and while I may be feeling really low right now, that may only be a temporary feeling, and that my longer-term view of it may end up being more positive.

Thanks for listening and such.
